standout_why: Compared against theofficejournal.com (attachable page), itechguides.com and TechRadar's best-portable-monitor guide. The first two carry no measurement of any kind and stop at 16-inch screens. The visible part of TechRadar's guide names no 18.5-inch model and no multi-screen extender. Tom's Hardware's guide body did not load, so it is not compared. The FOPO S999 store page gives only the maker's own ratings.
decides: It does not change the pick; it qualifies the screen ChatGPT ranked first. The UPERFECT Delta 18.5 is the only candidate with an independent reading, but that reading is on the Touch variant, not the $399.99 non-touch card. It covers less colour than claimed, and reviewers needed the wall adapter plus a second cable for full brightness, so it is a desk screen on mains power. No named reviewer has measured the FOPO S999, FOPO S788, Aura 18.5 Studio models, INVZI MagHub Quad Max or InnoView 18-inch; those rows can carry maker ratings only, labelled as such.
